description: Precision ADC readout with reference monitoring. STM32F103 reads ADS1115 via I2C. ADS1115 measures one external analog input and also monitors REF5050 output as a precision reference/calibration voltage. AMS1117-3.3 provides 3.3V digital power for STM32F103 and ADS1115. REF5050 is powered from VIN_5V. Common GND is used with analog/digital star-ground layout intent.

verification_assertions.desc: Common ground: LDO ground, STM32 grounds, ADS1115 ground, and REF5050 ground share one common GND.
3.3V digital rail: AMS1117 output powers STM32F103 and ADS1115.
REF5050 input is powered from VIN_5V.

I2C legal bundle mapping: accept one complete legal STM32F103 hardware I2C SDA/SCL pair to ADS1115, either I2C1 default, I2C1 remap, or I2C2. This forbids illegal mixed mappings such as PB7 for SDA together with PB8 for SCL.
Reference monitoring path: REF5050 output is monitored by ADS1115 as a precision reference/calibration voltage.

Critical node isolation: VIN_5V input, 3.3V digital rail, GND, REF5050 output, I2C SDA, I2C SCL, ADS1115 external analog input, and ADS1115 ALERT must remain distinct. I2C isolation is anchored on ADS1115-side pins so it is invariant to STM32 I2C pin selection.
Common ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
3.3V digital rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
VIN_5V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
ADS1115 external analog input AIN0 should be exposed as the measured analog input.
ADS1115 ADDR must select a valid I2C address: GND, VDD, SDA, or SCL.
ADS1115 external analog input AIN0 must not be shorted to digital I2C or ALERT nets.
ADS1115 reference-monitor input AIN2 must not be shorted to digital I2C or ALERT nets.
I2C SDA requires pull-up resistor to power. Anchored on ADS1115 SDA so the assertion is invariant to STM32 I2C pin selection.
I2C SCL requires pull-up resistor to power. Anchored on ADS1115 SCL so the assertion is invariant to STM32 I2C pin selection.
3.3V digital domain must have decoupling capacitor to ground.
VIN_5V input rail must have bypass capacitor to ground.
REF5050 precision output should have stabilization capacitor to ground.
